Authoritative Oblivion required-note template matrix, stored note-major as [5][8]. Classes: 0 Start/End; 1 Start/End; 2 Start/Attach/End; 3 Start/Detach/End; 4 Start/Hit/a:/End; 5 Start/Hit/End; 6 Start/Attack/End; 7 Start/Attach/Hold/Release/End. TESAnimGroup_InitKeyAndRequiredNotes selects a class column and advances +0x20 per note until an empty string, maximum five.
Required-note class 4 phase[0]: Start (template base 4 + 8*0). Crossing it advances the normalized slot state from -1 to 0.
AttackBow required note[0]: Start (template base 7 + 8*0).
Required-note class 4 phase[1]: Hit (template base 4 + 8*1). Crossing it advances slot state from 0 to 1; native normal-attack handling uses state 1 as its melee-hit gate.
AttackBow required note[1]: Attach (template base 7 + 8*1). Crossing this time advances slot-3 phase to 1.
Required-note class 4 phase[2]: a: marker (template base 4 + 8*2). Crossing it advances slot state from 1 to 2.
AttackBow required note[2]: Hold (template base 7 + 8*2). Crossing this time advances slot-3 phase to 2.
Required-note class 4 phase[3]: End (template base 4 + 8*3). Terminal threshold for class 4; crossing it advances state from 2 to 3 before terminal/repeat/stop handling.
AttackBow required note[3]: Release (template base 7 + 8*3). Crossing this time advances slot-3 phase to 3 and gates native held-arrow removal/projectile release.
AttackBow required note[4]: End (template base 7 + 8*4). Terminal threshold for phase class 7.
